explanation: The book pairs each symmetry with its conserved charge: rotation ↔ angular momentum, time translation ↔ energy, spatial translation ↔ linear momentum, gauge symmetry ↔ charge. Rotational invariance therefore gives angular-momentum conservation, while the other options are the charges belonging to the other three symmetries.
